نصطنع (form VIII)
# نَصْطَنِعُ (naṣṭaniʕu) /nasˤ.tˤa.ni.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِصْطَنَعَ (iṣṭanaʕa)
# نُصْطَنَعُ (nuṣṭanaʕu) /nusˤ.tˤa.na.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِصْطَنَعَ (iṣṭanaʕa)
# نَصْطَنِعَ (naṣṭaniʕa) /nasˤ.tˤa.ni.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِصْطَنَعَ (iṣṭanaʕa)
# نُصْطَنَعَ (nuṣṭanaʕa) /nusˤ.tˤa.
